summary: `Chain.pendingDir` replaces `Chain.pendingPath`: the ledger is a directory of `<tag>.json`, its own `*.json` is the listing, and a ship `git rm`s exactly what shipped

per.section: The ledger is a directory — one entry per file

acceptance: Every queue read and the ship resolve `Chain.pendingDir`; a `*.json` directly under it is an entry and a subdirectory is not walked; a file whose `tag` disagrees with its filename is refused naming both; `flume status` and `flume check` read the directory; `docs/MIGRATING-0.19.md` carries the series' breaking changes, the plan-state split among them.
tests: a *.json directly under the pending directory is an entry and a subdirectory is not walked
an entry file whose tag disagrees with its filename is refused naming both
a parse failure names the entry file it read
a ship removes exactly the shipped entries' files and edits no other entry
flume status reports pending: unparsable when one entry file is malformed
pins: an absent pending directory reads as nothing pending
notes: Tag uniqueness becomes the filesystem's, so the composed list schema's duplicate issue goes. This repo's own live queue is an operator cutover — `.flume/` is outside every phase's fence — and the legacy file rides planArtifacts so a plan tick can `git rm` it. MIGRATING-0.19 is the series page: it also owes the plan-state split (b6f882c3) and `PLAN_STATE_PATH` leaving `SHARED_PROMPT_DATA_KEYS`.

summary: pendingGate's third check: a gated commit leaves a claimed entry's file byte-identical, or is refused naming the entry and its holder

per.section: `pendingGate` — validation and fence pre-check as an opt-in builtin

acceptance: A commit that edits or removes a claimed entry's file fails pendingGate naming the entry and the holding pid; an edit to an unclaimed entry passes; the check runs afterMerge over the merged tree and `opts.hint` appends to its message as to the other two.
tests: pendingGate refuses a commit that edits a claimed entry's file, naming the entry and the holder
pendingGate refuses a commit that removes a claimed entry's file
pendingGate passes a commit that edits an unclaimed entry
opts.hint appends to the claim-check violation message
notes: afterMerge because a pre-merge read passes over exactly the tree the collision is not in; uncontended under one producer. It is the section's only merged-tree gate: there is no duplicate refusal beside it — the drain folds a duplicate instead (THE-DRAIN-FOLDS-A-DUPLICATE-FINDING).

new.description: the wave's merge/gate/revert/ledger stage: takes the per-entry results, answers the merge outcomes and gate rows the verdict needs

edit.description: `runFanout` calls the stage; the ship lock's span becomes a signature, not a brace pair

summary: Split `runFanout`'s merge stage — the ~500-line try from the cherry-pick loop to `clearMergingMarkers` — out of `src/waveTick.ts` into its own module
acceptance: `src/waveTick.ts` holds the wave's provisioning and agent fanout; the merge stage is a named function in its own file, taking the per-entry results and answering the merge outcomes and gate rows. Behavior-free: tsc, the default lane, and the export and citation pins hold it.
notes: Observed by the tick that shipped SIBLING-TICKS-TAKE-TURNS-AT-GIT: after the ship lock landed, the stage is one `try` whose only marker is an indent level (src/waveTick.ts is 1234 lines). No behavior moves — a split that changes an outcome is the wrong split.
